digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Historical mutation test score ceilings for signing.py and other modules are stale (814 vs 491 recorded mutants) and block unrelated work; a phased rollout with evidence gathering and per-shard enforcement modes must replace bulk acceptance or blocking.

Mutation shard enforcement progresses through three modes—advisory (nonblocking evidence collection), ratchet (preserve unchanged outcomes and block regressions), strict (all mutants killed or individually fingerprinted)—with deterministic promotion criteria requiring stable base/head pilot runs and documented equivalent-survivor fingerprints.

Fresh isolated base/head archives with pinned mutmut 3.7.0, timeout values from canonical manifest, per-shard 30-minute job caps, Python 3.12, clean-test preflight, and no cached mutation verdict state must guarantee reproducible gate outcomes.

Selector must map changed source, test, support, and infrastructure files to affected shards, preserve rename/deletion context, report unmatched Python tests, emit JSON for targeted and all-shard runs, and fail on unresolved refs.

Workflow must use selector-derived per-shard matrix jobs with exact Gerrit patchset checkout, vote.needs integration, push/PR parity, weekly/manual all-shard selection, and always-published structured evidence and artifacts.

Documentation must define phased promotion policy, evidence requirements, manifest authority, per-mutant timeout derivation, false-positive handling, and CI cadence while removing legacy score tables and budget headings.
